disclaimer: Reference and research infrastructure only. These libraries are not prosthesis templates and do not establish clinical suitability.

sources.name: 3D Slicer
sources.role: Author and review segmentations before design handoff
sources.guardrail: Keep the editable source representation and derived surface linked

sources.name: DICOM / DICOMweb
sources.role: Preserve source-study identity, coordinate frames, and derived-object links
sources.guardrail: Never reduce a study to a filename or a screenshot

sources.name: Open Anatomy Project
sources.guardrail: Atlas geometry is context, not a patient-matched device

sources.name: Z-Anatomy / BodyParts3D
sources.license: CC BY-SA; preserve attribution and share-alike terms
sources.role: Blender-native anatomy reference and semantic naming
sources.guardrail: Do not present reference anatomy meshes as prosthetic geometry

sources.name: OHIF + Cornerstone3D
sources.role: Reference-study viewing and task-based imaging workflows
sources.guardrail: Treat viewer annotations as reviewable derived data

sources.name: MONAI Label
sources.role: Research-only assisted annotation with human correction
sources.guardrail: Store model version, uncertainty, edits, and reviewer identity

sources.name: ITK / SimpleITK
sources.role: Reference implementation for image-to-surface processing and coordinate transforms
sources.guardrail: Keep image metadata and transforms attached to every derived surface

sources.name: VTK
sources.role: Reference toolkit for review visualization and mesh operations
sources.guardrail: Visualization is not a validation result; preserve the source and parameters

sources.name: Open3D
sources.role: Research reference for registration, inspection, and mesh processing
sources.guardrail: Registration error and coordinate frame must be reported, not hidden

sources.name: CGAL
sources.role: Candidate robust geometry kernel for a future manufacturing-grade path
sources.guardrail: Do not claim production watertightness until kernel settings and tolerances are tested

sources.name: Open CASCADE Technology
sources.license: LGPL with exception; verify distribution obligations
sources.role: Candidate solid/CAD kernel for milling-oriented design handoff
sources.guardrail: A surface preview is not a CAD solid or a verified toolpath

sources.name: Gmsh
sources.license: GPL; verify plugins and redistribution terms
sources.role: Research reference for volumetric meshing and finite-element preparation
sources.guardrail: Engineering simulation meshes are not clinical device approval evidence

sources.name: SlicerCMF
sources.license: Review repository and extension licenses before reuse
sources.role: Domain-specific research reference for craniofacial workflows
sources.guardrail: Use for method discovery and review, not as a hidden clinical dependency

sources.name: The Cancer Imaging Archive
sources.role: Test fixtures and research evaluation, not clinical input
sources.guardrail: Record collection, version, and usage terms per study

sources.name: NIH 3D
sources.guardrail: Attach asset license and intended-use metadata before import

designKits.name: Transtibial socket study
designKits.notClinicalRule: No universal relief or pressure pattern is implied

designKits.name: Cranial contour plate study
reviewChecks: derived surface traceable to source study
designKits.notClinicalRule: Contour continuity is a design intent, not a clinical approval
